title: The Man With The Seven Second Memory
summary: A documentary on Clive Wearing, a renowned musician whose brain was damaged by a virus in 1985, leaving him with a memory spanning only about seven seconds. It follows his life and condition.
why: HN points to it as the extended documentary on an extreme case of amnesia whenever memory loss or consciousness comes up.

quote.text: For another incredible case of retrogade amnesia, check the story of Clive Wearing
